Set at the measured value with ZERO headroom, deliberately: adding a visible sentence to any
of these surfaces turns CI red, so the accumulation has to be a decision instead of a drift.
To get back under budget, COLLAPSE — move the sentence into the group's 'Assumptions & method'
disclosure (keyedNote), into a title=/basis= hover, or inside a <Collapse>. All three are
budget-exempt because all three keep the fact reachable. DELETING a fact to fit is forbidden.
Raising a number here is allowed but never silent: it requires a line on the BACKLOG item
saying which sentence was added, why it must be visible by default, and what was removed.
